newsitem.title: USA: Duff may raise Conseco, Pioneer ratings.
newsitem.headline: Duff may raise Conseco, Pioneer ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it may raise the debt ratings of Conseco Inc and several of its subsidiaries, and the ratings of Pioneer Financial Services Inc.
Earlier, Conseco said it would buy Pioneer in a deal worth $477 million.

Duff said it may raise Conseco's senior debt rating of triple-B, American Life Holding Corp senior subordinated debt rating of triple-B-minus, Bankers Life Holding Corp senior subordinated debt of triple-B-minus, and Life Partners Group Inc senior subordinated debt of triple-B-minus.

Duff also reaffirmed Conseco's preferred stock rating of triple-B-minus, Conseco Financing Trust I trust originated preferred securities at triple-B-minus, and Conseco Financing Trust II trust originated preferred securities of triple-B-minus.
Duff also said it may raise the double-B rating of Pioneer's convertible subordinated notes and the single-A claims paying ability of its Pioneer Life Insurance Co unit.
The single-A-plus claims paying ability ratings of Pioneer's Manhattan National Life Insurance Co and Connecticut National Life Insurance Co are not affected.
